correctness.rationale: All sixteen continuous-time generator columns are explicitly specified, with irreducibility at fully saturated reservoirs. Exact symbolic stationary elimination yields D=-r(r-1)h P/H, H>0, degree-16 P with supplied coefficient polynomials. A(r)>0 for r>=2 and B(r)<0 for 1<r<=2 force at most two sign variations; P(0)>0, P(1/r)<0, leading coefficient>0 force two distinct simple positive roots. The packaged verifier recomputes the exact matrices and factorization and checks rational current signs, not merely approximations. The claim is finite, does not extrapolate to larger chains or weak driving.

value.rationale: A fixed spatial asymmetry r>1 with tunable common timescale h is a natural experimental/control parameter in exclusion transport. The theorem proves a universal, nonmonotonic two-switch polarity curve despite unchanged disorder contrast, ruling out one-threshold ordering heuristics. Exact root counts for all real contrasts, not a narrow numerical example, are relevant to far-from-equilibrium current rectification even without a thermodynamic limit.
